tavily.text:
To set up the PR Agent Python project, first clone the repository using `git clone`. Acquire the App private key, App ID from your app's settings page, and clone the repository. Copy the secrets template file and fill in the required information. Set the `PYTHONPATH` to include your `pr-agent` project directory using either Option A or B. Install dependencies with `uv sync` from the `uv.lock` file. Run tests with `PYTHONPATH=.` set to keep imports functional. Secrets should be supplied through environment variables and not persisted in code or configuration files.
To install the PR Agent Python documentation, first clone the repository using `git clone`. Then, acquire the App private key, App ID from your app's settings page. Copy the secrets template file and fill in the required information. Set the `PYTHONPATH` to include your `pr-agent` project directory using either Option A by adding `PYTHONPATH="/PATH/TO/PROJECTS/pr-agent` to your `.env` file or Option B by setting `PYTHONPATH` and running the CLI in one command. Install dependencies using `uv sync` and run tests with `PYTHONPATH=.` set to keep imports functional.

Do match the interpreter requirement declared in `pyproject.toml` (Python ≥ 3.12) and install dependencies with `uv sync` (runtime + dev, from `uv.lock`) before running tools.
 Do run tests with `PYTHONPATH=.` set to keep imports functional (for example `PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest tests/unittest/test_output_models.py -q`).
 Do adjust configuration through `.pr_agent.toml` or files under `pr_agent/settings/` instead of hard-coding values. [...] Install dependencies (runtime + dev) into a project 
Dependency management migrated to uv (#2509): `requirements.txt`, `requirements-dev.txt`, and the legacy `setup.py` are gone — dependencies now live in `pyproject.toml` with a committed `uv.lock`. Set up a dev environment with `uv sync` and run tools via `uv run`. Optional features are now extras (`lambda`, `langchain` — `uv sync --extra` ) or a dependency group (`similar-issue` — `uv sync --group similar-issue`), and Docker images install from the lockfile with `uv sync --frozen`. model_claims.text: When a bulk embedding request succeeds, the system uses a single request (fast path unchanged).
model_claims.source_quote: Keep the existing single-request fast path when it succeeds.

model_claims.text: When a bulk embedding request fails, the system retries in batches of up to 32 inputs before falling back to individual retries.
model_claims.source_quote: If it fails, retry in batches of up to 32 inputs; retry items individually only when their batch also fails.

model_claims.text: The system validates that the number of returned embeddings matches the number of inputs for bulk and batch requests, rejecting mismatched responses.
model_claims.source_quote: Validate the number of returned embeddings before accepting bulk or batch results, preventing misalignment with issue records.

model_claims.text: Input order of embeddings is preserved in the output, matching the order of inputs.
model_claims.source_quote: Preserve input order and existing partial- and total-failure behavior.

model_claims.text: Partial-failure behavior (zero-vector placeholders for failed items) and total-failure behavior (raising exception when all items fail) are unchanged.
model_claims.source_quote: Preserve input order and existing partial- and total-failure behavior.
